task_description: Determine whether famfs stores per-file or per-inode dentry/file references that are not released before generic_shutdown_super() calls shrink_dcache_for_umount(). The dentry refcount is exactly 1 for each affected file, suggesting a systematic per-file reference.
instructions: Read fs/famfs/famfs_inode.c: find and read famfs_fill_super in full - look for any stored dentry or file references in famfs_fs_info
Read fs/famfs/famfs_inode.c: find and read famfs_get_inode - does it bump a dentry refcount or store a reference anywhere?
Read fs/famfs/famfs_inode.c: find and read famfs_evict_inode - does it drop any dentry references?
Read fs/famfs/famfs_file.c: look for any open files, dentry references, or file structs stored in famfs_file_meta or per-inode private data
Check if famfs creates any 'internal' file opens (filp_open, dentry_open) at mount time or file creation time that would hold dentry references
Look for any use of dget(), igrab(), ihold(), or similar reference-bumping calls in famfs code that are not paired with dput()/iput() before unmount
Verify: can dentry refcount=1 be explained by a missing dput() or iput() somewhere in the famfs teardown path?

call_trace_summary: umount_check (WARNING: dentry still in use refcount=1)
context_from_bug.reproducer_summary: manual mount then unmount of famfs; multiple file dentries still in use with refcount=1 at unmount time

questions_to_answer: Does famfs_fill_super store any dentry or file references in famfs_fs_info that are not dropped before unmount?
Does famfs use dget()/ihold() anywhere that is not paired with a dput()/iput() before shrink_dcache_for_umount runs?
Does famfs_evict_inode drop all references held by inode private data?
Are there any filp_open() or dentry_open() calls in famfs that create long-lived file references?
